zh: 已有包裹不能转移，所以最大负载至少是原来的最大值；总量固定，最大负载也至少是平均负载向上取整。
取这两个下界中较大的 M：每个人都还能补到 M，剩余总空间 nM − 原总量 不小于 extra，新包裹一定放得下。
累加原负载总和并记录最大值，总量加上 extra 后算出向上取整的平均值 (总量+n−1)/n，与原最大值取较大者输出；总量可达约 10^15，用 64 位整数。
en: Existing parcels cannot move, so the maximum load is at least the original maximum; with a fixed total, it is also at least the average load rounded up.
Take M as the larger of these two bounds: everyone can still be filled up to M, and the free space nM - original total is at least extra, so the new parcels always fit.

Sum the original loads and track the maximum, add extra to the total, compute the rounded-up average (total+n-1)/n, and output the larger of it and the original maximum; the total can reach about 10^15, so use 64-bit integers.

explanationEn:
## Approach

The answer is the larger of the original maximum load and the total number of parcels divided by n, rounded up.

## Proof of correctness

The maximum cannot be lower than the original maximum load, nor lower than the average load rounded up. Taking M as the larger of the two, every initial value is ≤M and the remaining capacity nM−sum(a)≥extra; filling it parcel by parcel accommodates all the new parcels, so the lower bound is attainable.

## Complexity

Time O(n), space O(1) apart from the input.
